task: Task 1: check direct AQA Year 1 Chemistry recall coverage for mass and measurement vocabulary
auditBasis: Read the live core deck and pre-v218 Chemistry supplement questions, including AS Atomic structure, Amount of substance, Ideal gas equation, practical and analysis flashcards. Topic counts alone are not evidence of specification completion.

coverage.finding: Relative formula mass is explicitly named by AQA for ionic compounds, but no existing AS mock flashcard front tested this definition.
Separate recall of formula units versus discrete molecules complements existing NaCl lattice reasoning.
Relative atomic mass definition existed, but no separate direct prompt checked that relative mass ratios have no units.
Existing n=m/Mr and gas-molar-mass cards did not directly check g mol^-1 molar-mass units.
Hydration calculations and a card on a hydrated salt containing water of crystallisation existed; add reverse definition rather than duplicate calculation.
AQA requires answers respecting input precision; new card deliberately restricts sig-fig rule to multiplication and division to avoid false rule for sums/differences.
Definition of measurement accuracy was not a direct current Chemistry AS mock prompt.
Definition of measurement precision was not a direct current Chemistry AS mock prompt.

next: Continue individual AS Chemistry mock answer review beyond these requirements, then independently audit real exam-question marking and past-paper source index.
